college.name: KLE Society's BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications)
college.affiliation: Affiliated to Rani Channamma University / Recognized under KLE Society
college.established: KLE Society has been running educational institutions since 1916

course.name: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
course.eligibility: Candidate must have passed 10+2 (PUC) from a recognized board with Mathematics/Computer Science as one of the subjects, with a minimum of 45% aggregate marks (40% for reserved categories).
admission_process: Fill the online/offline application form available on the KLE college website or admission office
Submit required documents (marks cards, TC, migration certificate, caste certificate if applicable)
Merit-based shortlisting as per PUC marks
Attend counselling/interaction session at the college
Pay admission fee to confirm the seat
course.fee_structure: Approximate annual fee ranges between INR 35,000 - 60,000 depending on category and hostel/other facilities. Exact fee should be confirmed with the college admission office.
subjects_covered: Programming in C, C++, Java, Python

important_dates.application_start: Usually starts in May every year
important_dates.application_end: Usually closes by end of July / early August

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for BCA admission?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have completed 10+2 (PUC) with at least 45% marks (40% for reserved category) from a recognized board, preferably with Mathematics or Computer Science.

faqs.question: Is there an entrance exam for BCA?
faqs.answer: Generally, admission is merit-based on PUC marks. Some years a common entrance test may be conducted; please confirm with the admission office for the current year.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the BCA course?
faqs.answer: The BCA course is a 3-year full-time program divided into 6 semesters.

faqs.question: Does the college provide hostel facility?
faqs.answer: Yes, KLE Society provides hostel facilities for both boys and girls, subject to availability.

faqs.question: What are the career opportunities after BCA?
faqs.answer: Graduates can pursue roles like Software Developer, Web Developer, System Analyst, Database Administrator, or continue higher studies like MCA/MBA.
